Newly renovated 3BR/1.5BA apartment in a classic San Francisco Victorian available now for the first time in years!
The unit has three bedrooms, one and a half bathroom, a large kitchen as well as a sunroom in the back with washer/dryer hookups.
Spectacular location at the heart of the 25th and Clement Street corridor: walk out the front door and be at some of the best restaurants in San Francisco within seconds, such as Fiorella, Bill's Place, Hard Knox Cafe, Violet's, Gordo Taqueria and more. Dragon Beaux, PPQ and other amazing restaurants are also close by on Geary Boulevard. Whatever food you are craving, you can probably find it in the area, whether it's Russian, Japanese, Vietnamese, Chinese, Thai, Indian, Mediterranean, etc. Multiple coffee shops and delis are available as well. Restaurants galore!
Almost everything you need can be found close by: a gym, independent movie theater, salons, supermarkets, convenience stores, Asian markets, produce markets, etc. The location is perfect for those who love small businesses.
Great transit access: a block or less away from multiple Muni lines such as the 1, 29, 38 and 38R to/from Downtown, Financial District, Chinatown, Stonestown Galleria, San Francisco State and points in between. For nature lovers, this place is blocks away from the Presidio and Baker Beach. Golden Gate Park and Ocean Beach are also nearby.
For those who drive: there is easy access to the Golden Gate Bridge for points north and same for 19th Avenue to points south. Just head east on Geary to go Downtown.
Parking: there is metered parking right in front. There is also free unmetered street parking half a block away in either direction.
